title: In the beginning
note: Before anything else, God spoke and light came. Notice how the story begins with God acting, not us.
note_sw: Kabla ya kitu chochote, Mungu alisema na nuru ikaja. Angalia jinsi hadithi inavyoanza na Mungu akitenda, si sisi.
question: Where do you need light in your life today?
question_sw: Ni wapi unahitaji nuru maishani mwako leo?

title: The Lord is my shepherd
note: A shepherd leads, restores and stays close, even in hard valleys.
note_sw: Mchungaji huongoza, hurejesha nguvu, na hukaa karibu, hata katika mabonde magumu.
question: What is one worry you can hand over today?
question_sw: Ni wasiwasi gani mmoja unaoweza kumkabidhi Mungu leo?

title: God so loved
note: God's love came first, and it was given freely.
note_sw: Upendo wa Mungu ulianza kwanza, na ulitolewa bure.
question: Who can you show that kind of love to today?
question_sw: Ni nani unayeweza kumwonyesha upendo wa aina hiyo leo?
